renderRule: Use x()/t() at render time; never embed user-facing English prose in account/admin/master-admin templates.
languageRule: Resolve against selected locale; supported non-English missing/empty/whitespace/explicit [key] values use authoritative English catalog fallback; unsupported/unavailable locale also falls back to English; native/reviewed completion remains separately governed.
extensibility: Language registry driven; no hard-coded 23-language ceiling.
designRule: Shared account/admin/master-admin components must reuse the same typography, spacing, card, button, status and empty-state primitives.
